preset.title: Start from a preset
preset.hint: A preset fills in the switches below. You can then change any of them.

sections.title: Sections
sections.hint: Nothing is shared until you switch it on.

figures.title: Figures
figures.hint: What the sections above are allowed to say. Each is off until you turn it on.

published.title: Published figures
published.hint: A shared page shows what was last published, not a live feed. It says so on the page.

links.title: Share links
links.hint: A link works whatever your visibility is set to, until it expires or you revoke it.
links.copyOnce: Copy this link now — it is shown only once.
links.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.hint: A snapshot freezes today's figures at their own address. It never updates.

identity.slugHint: Changing this makes the old address stop working. It never points at anyone else.
identity.displayNameHint: Free text. Your email address is never shown.

errors.linkMissing: That share link does not exist.

PRIVATE.title: This portfolio is private
PRIVATE.detail: Its owner has not shared it, or has stopped sharing it.

LINK.title: This share link is not available
LINK.detail: The link may have expired, been revoked, or never have been valid. Ask whoever shared it for a new one.

SNAPSHOT.title: This snapshot is not available
SNAPSHOT.detail: It may have been deleted by its owner.

public.insightsHint: Generated by rules over this portfolio's own figures
public.nothingSharedBody: The owner has not chosen any sections to share yet.

footer.snapshotNote: This page is a snapshot and does not update.
footer.disclaimer: Figures are the owner's own records, shared as published. Stockly does not verify them, and nothing here is investment advice.

freshness.pricesStale: Some prices were unavailable and cost was used instead.
freshness.untranslated: {count, plural, one {# holding} other {# holdings}} could not be converted to {currency} and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} excluded from totals.
